headline: Trump Suggests Huang Return as Nvidia CEO Following US-China AI Talks
summary: US President Donald Trump stated that Jensen Huang should return as chief executive of Nvidia following an apology. The statement follows discussions with Chinese President Xi Jinping amid US investigations into chip exports.
why: Nvidia is the world's dominant designer of graphics processing units essential for training and running artificial intelligence models.

impacts.name: NVIDIA Corporation
impacts.why: Executive leadership comments and diplomatic scrutiny impact investor sentiment around Nvidia's business strategy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding Nvidia's executive leadership and trade controls influenced tech market sentiment.
